title: Early historical cutoff and peer interpretation
question: 解释2024年4月的按计划完成率、历史比较及同类比较。1月是否是真正的历史平均？能否推断后续月份表现或当前延误？

checks: April completion 84.44%, release 88.53%, historical 79.87%, difference +4.57 pp, peers 86.12% if mentioned.
April has three prior months Jan-Mar 2024; January initializes with zero prior months, not independent past performance.
Same-category mean includes NAN and has three airports.
Only Jan-Apr 2024 retrieved; no later monthly or annual figures and no current delay inference.
No five-point adverse anomaly exists within this selected history.

review.logic: Correctly distinguishes April three-prior-month baseline, January zero-prior initialization, four-row cutoff, zero anomalies and lack of current flight-level inference.
review.evidence: All quoted rates and April weather figures match supplied records. Table rows are cited, but repeated baseline and peer figures in a separate paragraph lack local citations (four citation advisories).
review.unsupportedClaims: No unsupported current delay, completed action or future service promise found.
review.proposedFacts: Three explicitly unapplied proposals: label January initialization, request independent current observation, keep passenger copy a draft. No proposed fact was applied.
notes: One additional wording advisory is a false positive on 不能作为已发送通知, which denies that the draft is a sent notice.
Statement that independent sources are not established should be read as no independent corroboration of the single report.

warnings.message: 79.87% is not supported by its cited sources, metric type, unit, and precision.
warnings.excerpt: The baseline behind  79.87%  is only 3 prior months, 2024-01 to 2024-03, with the assessed month excluded — despite the column being labelled as a 12-month figure. So April ran above its own short baseline but below the peer mean of  86.12% . Peer count is 3 with NAN included.
